title: Crunchyroll Adds Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta Anime Special in India
content:
Crunchyroll began streaming in India on Wednesday The Saga of Tanya the Evil: Operation Desert Pasta special . The anime special is streaming in Japanese with English subtitles and with an English dub .

The 17-minute short debuted during a livestreamed event for the franchise in June 2021.

Saga of Tanya the Evil II ( Yōjo Senki II ), the anime's second season , debuted on the AT-X channel on July 8 and also runs on Tokyo MX , Sun TV , KBS Kyoto , BS11 , and TV Aichi . Crunchyroll is streaming the season in India as it airs in Japan. Amazon Prime Video 's Anime Times is also streaming the season.

Like the first season, the second season inspired a "Yōjo Shenki 2" (The Shaga [sic] of Tanya the Evil 2) mini-anime. Each mini anime episode runs immediately after each Saga of Tanya the Evil II episode on AT-X , and then streams on the Kadokawa Anime Channel on YouTube starting that Thursday at midnight JST for two weeks. The new mini anime also features the new members of the Salamander Kampfgruppe.

The second season was announced in June 2021.

The television anime adaptation of the novels premiered in January 2017. Ani-One Asia 's YouTube channel streamed the first season in India in November 2020.

The anime also had a film that opened in Japan in February 2019, with a returning staff and cast.

Yen Press licensed both the original Saga of Tanya the Evil light novel series and Chika Tōjō 's manga adaptation, and it describes the story:

High above the blood- and mud-soaked trenches, a young girl pits herself against army mages in high stakes aerial duels with bullets, spells, and bayonets. Her name is Tanya Degurechaff and she is the Devil of the Rhine, one of the greatest soldiers the Empire has ever seen! But inside her mind lives a ruthless, calculating ex-salaryman who enjoyed a peaceful life in Japan until he woke up in a war-torn world. Reborn as a destitute orphaned girl with nothing to her name but memories of a previous life, Tanya will do whatever it takes to survive, even if she can find it only behind the barrel of a gun!

Carlo Zen and Shinobu Shinotsuki launched the novel series in 2013, and Kadokawa published the 14th volume in September 2023. Tōjo launched the manga in Monthly Comp Ace in 2016, Kadokawa published the 35th volume on August 25.
author: ANN

title: 3rd Batch of Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, English Dubs of Naruto Shippūden Anime Stream on Crunchyroll
content:
Crunchyroll released the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of the anime on July 6 with plans to roll out additional batches of dubbed episodes through September 2026. It began streaming the dubs of episodes 113-175 on August 17.

Crunchyroll describes the anime:

Now in his teens, Naruto Uzumaki returns to his village after years of training. Alongside his fellow ninjas, Naruto faces a new threat in the mysterious Akatsuki organization. He'll train harder than ever and push his will to his limits.

Crunchyroll is streaming 17 seasons of Naruto Shippūden in India.

Crunchyroll is streaming all nine seasons of Naruto in India. It added the Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and English dubs for seasons four, five, and six of the anime in May 2025. It added the Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, and English dubs for season seven later that month and the Hindi, Tamil, and Telugu dubs of seasons eight and nine in June 2025.

' Sony YAY!' began airing the Naruto anime's first season in August 2022. It aired the second season in December 2022. The channel began airing Naruto Shippūden in March 2024. The company launched the Anime Booth channel on Airtel Digital TV with Naruto as one of its launch titles in February 2024.

Netflix is currently streaming all nine seasons of the original Naruto anime in India. It began streaming the first four seasons of the Naruto Shippūden anime in India in August 2022 and began streaming seasons four through nine in September 2022. The service began streaming seasons 10 through 18 of the anime in October 2022. Anime Times also added the series to Amazon Prime Video in February 2024.

Four "brand-new" episodes of the original Naruto anime (pictured right) were slated to air in September 2023 to celebrate the franchise's 20th anniversary, but are delayed .

title: 'Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston' Reveals Additional Cast, Second Promo, Two Consecutive Cours
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Umikaze Minamino 's Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku ( Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden ) light novel revealed additional cast and the second promotional video on Tuesday.

The anime will air for two consecutive cours, beginning on October 6 at 9:25 p.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by BS Nippon TV and MBS. A special stage event and advance screening of the first three episodes will also be held at esports TOKYO BAY studio on September 22.

Cast Hyurence Altoire: Junichi Suwabe ( Akuyaku Reijou wa Ringoku no Outaishi ni Dekiai sareru ) Sharro White: Maaya Uchida ( Eris no Seihai ) Asuma: Kazuyuki Okitsu ( Marriagetoxin ) Bendelio: Kouichi Sakaguchi ( Isekai Shoukan wa Nidome desu )

VTuber Watame Tsunomaki ( One Piece: Gyojin Tou-hen ) is performing the opening theme "Respawn!!," which was previewed in the promotional video below.

Motoki Nakanishi ( Isekai Shoukan wa Nidome desu ) is directing the anime at Konami animation , with Nichita Seki ( Kidou Senshi Gundam: GQuuuuuuX assistant episode director) serving as assistant director. Gigaemon Ichikawa ( Sozai Saishuka no Isekai Ryokouki ) is handling the series composition. Yuuki Itou ( Nige Jouzu no Wakagimi animation director) and Kana Tosaoka ( Hana wa Saku, Shura no Gotoku animation director) are designing the characters, while Naoki Endou ( Love Live! Nijigasaki Gakuen School Idol Doukoukai ) is composing the music.

Minamino penned the fantasy novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website from May 2019 to January 2021. Hobby Japan began publishing the novel under its HJ Bunko imprint with illustrations by Jishaku in September 2022 and by Kanata Katana from the third volume onwards in September 2023. The 11th volume was released on June 1.

Kodai Kabuto began serializing a manga adaptation on the Manga UP! platform in November 2022. Square Enix published the eighth volume on February 6.

J-Novel Club licensed the light novel for digital release in English in November 2023 and published the tenth volume on September 1.

Square Enix began simulpublishing the manga in English on its Manga UP! platform in March 2024.

title: We Are Aliens Film Streams 'Theme Song Trailer'
content:
NOTHING NEW began streaming a "theme song trailer," featuring the song "Sasakure" (Split) by singer adieu, for its We Are Aliens ( Ware Ware wa Uchūjin ) anime film with director Kōhei Kadowaki on Tuesday. Kadowaki directed the video, which previews part of the theme song that has not been made public before.

We Are Aliens centers on Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, two boys who as elementary school students became close friends, but jealousy and misunderstandings eventually drove them apart. Years have passed and the two boys have gone in different directions in life. But when the memories from their past come back, they must face what happened between them years ago.

The film stars Ryōta Bandō ( Fureru. , live-action How to Train Your Dragon's Japanese dub ) as Tsubasa, and Amane Okayama ( Blue Giant , live-action I''s , Hirayasumi ) as Gyōtarō, when both characters are young adults. Child actors Yūto Maki and Tasuku Nakagome — who were both selected through auditions — voice Tsubasa and Gyōtarō, respectively, when they were younger. Other cast members include Sakurazaka46 idol group member Ten Yamasaki as Konatsu, comedian Kemuri Matsui as Batahara, Gaku Sano as Tsubasa's friend Seiya Toda, Reika Ōzeki as young Seiya, Arisa Sasaki as Toda's friend Elmo Matsushita, and Edo Harumi as a calligraphy teacher.

Kadowaki, who created the second BEASTARS season's ending sequence and music videos for YOASOBI , served as the film's planner, scriptwriter, director, storyboard artist, and editor. Yaffle , who previously produced music for Fujii Kaze, Kenshi Yonezu , and others, composed the music. NOTHING NEW planned and produced the upcoming film, and French studio Miyu Productions ( Ghost Cat Anzu , A New Dawn ) collaborated on the production, after joining on the project in June 2025.

The film will open in Japan on September 25. The film screened at the Directors' Fortnight of the Cannes Film Festival on May 14, and screened in competition at the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, which ran from June 21 to 27. The Ottawa International Film Festival (OIAF), the Melbourne International Film Festival (MIFF), and New Zealand International Film Festival (NZIFF) are screening the film. OIAF takes place from September 23-27, MIFF took place from August 6-23, and NZIFF took place from July 29-August 9. The film will screen in the "Japanese Animation Special: Masterpieces of Madness, Exhilarating Prospects 12+1" category of the 31st Busan International Film Festival (BIFF), which will take place on October 6-15

Sales company CHARADES licensed the film to the distributors Hooray Films in Taiwan, Shaw Organisation in Singapore, Intercontinental Film Distributors in Hong Kong, and Sahamongkol Film in Thailand. CHARADES is handling international sales of the film.

The staff launched a crowdfunding campaign in November 2025 on the Motion Gallery website. The campaign aimed to cover production and advertising costs, specifically to "improve the quality of the work" and to "distribute the film more widely." The campaign ended on March 2 and exceeded its 8 million yen (about US$50,365) target and raised 9,604,510 (about US$60,467) yen.

NOTHING NEW is a small film company that was founded in 2022 with the aim "to create a world where talent is not crushed."

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 (Finale) "Mugendai MewType" Preview Released
content:
BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 preview has been released on Tuesday. The episode is set to premiere on September 10 at 11:00 PM JST and it is titled “Mugendai Mewtype.” The synopsis is as follows:

Even the feelings that were hidden are turned into songs as they are. Remaining different, yet standing in the same place. From this stage, it’s going to get even more fun. That voice will spread everywhere.

Midori Goto ( BanG Dream! It’s MyGo!!!!! , Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast ) is writing the episode’s script with the direction of Kotaro Ogawa and the storyboard is done by Tomomi Umezu ( Blue Archive The Animation Episode 5). Kenta Sasaki is handling the storyboard of the episode’s live part.

NICHICALINE is animating with Tomomi Umezu as the director and Hiroshi Morita is the assistant director. Midori Goto is in charge of the series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo are in charge of character design. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

• Yui Tsukada as Popo

• Runa Sanai as Manager

• Maaya Uchida as Koharu

• Konomi Kohara as Kaede

• Miho Okasaki as Yuina

BanG Dream! is a multimedia music franchise created by Bushiroad president Takaaki Kidani. The project launched in January 2015, and it originally began as a manga before expanding into various media formats. Since then, BanG Dream has grown to include additional manga series, TV anime series, live concerts, singles and albums, VTuber projects, and a mobile rhythm game BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!

title: The World is Dancing Anime Casts Nobunaga Shimazaki
content:
Shochiku announced on Monday that the television anime of Kazuto Mihara 's The World Is Dancing manga has cast Nobunaga Shimazaki as the protagonist Oniyasha as a young adult. The young adult version of Oniyasha appeared briefly in the end of the anime's 10th episode last week, and will feature in the anime's 11th episode on Wednesday. Shochiku unveiled the below visual for Oniyasha.

Shochiku describes the story:

In 1374, amid the turmoil of the Northern and Southern Courts' long running conflict, a boy named Oniyasha is born into a family of sarugaku theater performers. He spends his days in a kind of quiet gloom, haunted by a simple but persistent question: Why do people dance? Then, one day, he witnesses a dance that he feels to be “good”—and everything begins to change. This is the story of the beautiful young boy who would one day shape the art of Noh and be remembered as Zeami.

The anime premiered on Tokyo MX and KBS Kyoto in Japan on July 2. HIDIVE streamed the anime's first episode on June 29, and the world premiere of the second episode screened at this year's Anime Expo event on July 2. The series began streaming on Amazon Prime Video on June 29, ahead of its July 2 television broadcast. HIDIVE is also streaming an English dub for the anime.

Mihara launched the manga in Kodansha 's Morning magazine in March 2021, and the series ended in October 2022. Kodansha published six compiled book volumes of the manga. Kodansha USA Publishing licensed the manga and published the manga's six volumes digitally.

title: Geek Pictures Unveils Panchsheela Indian-Japanese Magical Girl Animation
content:
Geek Pictures India announced on August 25 that it is working on what it described as an "original magical-girl anime" titled Panchsheela . Geek Pictures India describes the project as an India–Japan creative collaboration.

The project's official website introduces the story:

When the ancient darkness Daki Daayan breaks free after centuries of imprisonment, five ordinary desi schoolgirls—Mezi, Kaya, Amba, Zoonie and Tara—are chosen as the Panchsheela: magical warriors who each embody the power of a sacred chakra. Guided by their clumsy mentor Guru Garu and five animal companions harbouring mystical knowledge, they battle Negatives—forlorn people that Daki transforms into her army of destruction—while surviving homework, heartbreak, bad hostel food and each other. Can this magical sisterhood step up to the challenges of everyday school life while learning to channelise their powers to tackle Daki's torment?

Geek Pictures India is a subsidiary of Tokyo-based creative studio Geek Pictures . Geek Pictures also owns the Geek Toys anime studio subsidiary. Geek Toys merged with Geek Pictures in 2023.

contentBlocks.credit: Image via Panchsheela anime's X/Twitter account

contentBlocks.text: The project's official website introduces the story:

When the ancient darkness Daki Daayan breaks free after centuries of imprisonment, five ordinary desi schoolgirls—Mezi, Kaya, Amba, Zoonie and Tara—are chosen as the Panchsheela: magical warriors who each embody the power of a sacred chakra. Guided by their clumsy mentor Guru Garu and five animal companions harbouring mystical knowledge, they battle Negatives—forlorn people that Daki transforms into her army of destruction—while surviving homework, heartbreak, bad hostel food and each other. Can this magical sisterhood step up to the challenges of everyday school life while learning to channelise their powers to tackle Daki's torment?
Geek Pictures India is a subsidiary of Tokyo-based creative studio Geek Pictures . Geek Pictures also owns the Geek Toys anime studio subsidiary. Geek Toys merged with Geek Pictures in 2023.

title: BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 (Finale) "Mugendai MewType" Preview Released
content:
BanG Dream! YUME∞MITA Episode 13 preview has been released on Tuesday. The episode is set to premiere on September 10 at 11:00 PM JST and it is titled “Mugendai Mewtype.” The synopsis is as follows:

Even the feelings that were hidden are turned into songs as they are. Remaining different, yet standing in the same place. From this stage, it’s going to get even more fun. That voice will spread everywhere.

Midori Goto ( BanG Dream! It’s MyGo!!!!! , Ave Mujica: The Die is Cast ) is writing the episode’s script with the direction of Kotaro Ogawa and the storyboard is done by Tomomi Umezu ( Blue Archive The Animation Episode 5). Kenta Sasaki is handling the storyboard of the episode’s live part.

NICHICALINE is animating with Tomomi Umezu as the director and Hiroshi Morita is the assistant director. Midori Goto is in charge of the series composition, while Osamu Nobusawa and Mochipuyo are in charge of character design. The cast includes:

• Arale Nakamachi (vocals)

• Nonoka Miyanaga (lead guitar)

• Ritsu Minetsuki (rhythm guitar)

• Miyako Fuji (keyboard)

• Yuno Sengoku (DJ)

• Kaede Hondo as Viola

• Wakana Maruoka as Bell

• Yui Tsukada as Popo

• Runa Sanai as Manager

• Maaya Uchida as Koharu

• Konomi Kohara as Kaede

• Miho Okasaki as Yuina

BanG Dream! is a multimedia music franchise created by Bushiroad president Takaaki Kidani. The project launched in January 2015, and it originally began as a manga before expanding into various media formats. Since then, BanG Dream has grown to include additional manga series, TV anime series, live concerts, singles and albums, VTuber projects, and a mobile rhythm game BanG Dream! Girls Band Party!

title: MARRIAGETOXIN Season 2 Main Visual Revealed
content:
MARRIAGETOXIN has revealed its main visual for Season 2, which is scheduled to begin streaming in January 2027 . A new visual reveal PV was also revealed, along with an interview with director Motonobu Hori about the upcoming season.

The Season 2 visual features the large bridge where Hikaru Gero saved Mei Kinosaki in the first episode. According to the announcement, the composition is intended to emphasize the chemistry between the two as a duo.

Hori confirmed that production on Season 2 is progressing smoothly and teased several developments coming for Gero and Kinosaki. Characters from the first season will return, while Gero will also encounter a new potential marriage partner.

“An appealing new marriage prospect appears for Gero, and of course there are scenes in which the relationship between Gero and Kinosaki deepens through various developments, so I hope people enjoy that side of it as well.”

Hori said the goal is to maintain the first season’s momentum despite the demanding production, describing his intention to make a season that carries viewers through from beginning to end with the same energy.

The director also reflected on the response to Season 1 at Anime Expo 2026. Hori attended the event alongside Haruki Ishiya, who voices Gero, and Shion Wakayama, who voices Kinosaki, and said the enthusiastic overseas audience surprised him.

“I had thought the content of the source material was very Japanese, so I honestly did not imagine that audiences overseas would take to it so warmly.”

Discussing his approach to the adaptation, Hori explained that one of MARRIAGETOXIN ‘s defining qualities is how quickly it shifts between comedy, action, emotional drama and darker material. Rather than treating each genre separately, the production uses elements like music to connect scenes and keep a consistent emotional flow. He also emphasized that the action was deliberately treated seriously, preserving the contrast between Joumyaku’s absurd comedy and Mizuki Yoda’s polished artwork.

You can watch the visual reveal PV below.

The first season of the anime ran for a total of 13 episodes, covering the Water Master , Sound Master , and the Beast Master arcs. Studio BONES Film is back handling the animation production, with Crunchyroll streaming the anime worldwide. Season 2 will premiere in January 2027.

The voice cast for the anime includes:

• Shion Wakayama as Mei Kinosaki

• Haruki Ishiya as Hikaru Gero

• Anna Nagase as Kyoko Himekawa

• Mariya Ise as Shizuku Ushio

• Asaki Yuikawa as Shiori Ureshino

• Soma Saito as Genya Naruko

• Hinano Shirahama as Kimie Arashiyama

• Simba Tsuchiya as Piichi Nakagawa

The anime is directed by Motonobu Hori, who is known for Carole & Tuesday and Metallic Rogue . Serving as Chief Animation Director and Character Designer isohei Tokuoka, who served as Chief Animation Director for SK8 the Infinity and as Character Designer and Chief Animation Director for The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity . Studio BONES Film is known for animating big hits, including My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON and Gachiakuta .

Official synopsis:

For centuries, the deadly arts have been perfected by those known as the Masters. Among them, the Poison Masters of the Five Great Families hold the most fearsome power and influence. Hikaru Gero, heir to the Poison Masters’ Gero Family, has lived his entire life in the underworld, far removed from love or marriage. But when the Gero Family head decrees that Hikaru’s sister must bear an heir to preserve the bloodline – by force if necessary – Hikaru resolves to protect her at all costs. It is then that Hikaru encounters Mei Kinosaki, a brilliant marriage swindler who becomes the target of his latest job. Realizing that the only way of solving the family succession problem and protecting his sister is through marriage, Hikaru impulsively asks Mei for help in finding a bride. “That’s the first time anyone’s ever proposed like that.” And so, with the cunning marriage swindler Mei as his advisor, elite assassin Hikaru embarks on the most challenging mission of his life: finding a wife! Their goal: the ultimate marriage. This is the world’s toughest mission for love, brought to you by the ultimate duo – an assassin and a marriage swindler! To win love, you’ve got to play with poison. A high-stakes mission for the ultimate duo begins!

MARRIAGETOXIN full anime staff:

• Director: Motonobu Hori

• Series Composition & Script: Kimiko Ueno

• Character Design & Chief Animation Director: Kohei Tokuoka

• Sub Character Design: Yurika Sako

• Costume Design: Kotono

• Prop Design: Ayumi Nagaki, Ryo Hirata

• Art Design: Toshiki Amata

• Art: Bihou

• Color Design: Hiroko Umezaki

• Photography Director: Go Kanbayashi

• 3DCG: SANZIGEN Inc.

• CG Animation Director: Taiki Nagashima

• Editing: Kumiko Sakamoto

• Sound Director: Haru Yamada

• Sound Effects: Tomokazu Mii

• Music: Taisei Iwasaki, yuma yamaguchi

• Production Supervision: Bones

• Animation Production: Bones Film

• Production: MARRIAGETOXIN Project
